Level 13 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Ability to use Artisan's Tools as a Spellcasting Focus
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 2
Order: Craft

Two magewright hirelings skilled at making magic items work here.

Crafting Assistants. If you craft a magic item in your Bastion using the Dungeon Master's Guide rules, one or both hirelings can assist you, reducing the time required.

Craft: Magic Item. The hirelings craft a Common or Uncommon magic item of your choice from the Dungeon Master's Guide. The facility has the required tool, and they are proficient with it and with Arcana; they assist each other, reducing the time required. If the item lets its user cast spells, they have those spells prepared.

Charge Refreshment. Whenever a magic item in your Bastion regains charges, it regains 1 extra expended charge.

Source: Eberron: Forge of the Artificer.
